title: AssetProfile
description: Published by the CNC 419 GRC platform via GET /api/v1/assets/profile. Consumed by the CNC 418 Red Team (to prioritise high-value targets) and the CNC 411 Blue Team (to weight alert severity).

ip_or_url.description: Where the asset lives in the lab. MUST resolve to the Red Team target allowlist (localhost / 127.0.0.1 / approved lab subnet).

criticality_tier.description: Business criticality. Drives Red Team prioritisation and Blue Team severity weighting.

mtd_minutes.description: Maximum Tolerable Downtime in minutes. Must satisfy RTO + WRT <= MTD in the GRC BIA validator.

rpo_minutes.description: Recovery Point Objective in minutes. Independent data-loss bound (NOT part of the RTO/WRT/MTD timeline).

applicable_standards.description: Frameworks this asset is in scope for.
